svg.text: Kestrel loan platform on AWS: production
Account 768499314608, region eu-west-1 (Ireland). Dev is the same code with different variables (one AZ for endpoints, smaller tasks, single AZ database).

g.text: Request and data flow (numbered in order)

svg.text: Plan on PR, apply on merge
VPC 10.30.0.0/16 (no NAT gateway, no internet route from private or isolated subnets)
HTTPS 443, TLS 1.3 and 1.2 (restricted ciphers). Port 80 only redirects to HTTPS.
Certificate in ACM (self signed until the client gives a domain, ADR 0008)
0.5 vCPU, 1 GB, non root user. 2 to 20 tasks across both AZs
Scales on requests per task and CPU; floor of 5 on 25th to 28th
Own task role: encrypt and hash BVN, never decrypt
Network interfaces in both AZs, at most 5 at once
Approve if amount is at most 3 x salary
Row lock makes a repeated message harmless
VPC endpoints (one per service in each AZ): the only way out of the private subnets
Interface endpoints: ecr.api, ecr.dkr, logs, secretsmanager, kms, sqs, sns. Security group allows HTTPS from the VPC only.
S3 gateway endpoint (free): image layers and the artifacts bucket (ADR 0006).
on every call to an AWS service. A compromised task cannot reach the internet to send data out.
Fixed cost about USD 112 a month in prod instead of NAT gateways and their data charges.
Accepts connections only from the API and scorer
Backups 7 days, point in time restore (RPO about 5 min)
data key. BVN stored only as ciphertext plus HMAC.
if eu-west-1a or the primary fails
A message per application. After 3 failed tries it moves to the DLQ;
any message there raises an alarm.
Other teams subscribe without code changes.
data: database, its password secret, backups
bvn-encrypt: BVN ciphertext (no role can decrypt today)
bvn-mac: HMAC lookup hash, key never leaves KMS (ADR 0007)
Yearly rotation (except HMAC), 7 day deletion wait, uses logged
Database password created and rotated every 7 days by RDS.
Not in code, env files or Terraform state.
Scan on push; pipeline stops on a critical finding.
AES-256 at rest (code, no customer data)
JSON logs with one request ID from API to queue to scorer.
BVN masked; request bodies never logged. 30 day retention.
Dashboard: requests, errors, p95, queue, DLQ, database.
Alarms: 5xx rate, p95 latency, any DLQ message, low storage,
each linked to a runbook entry. Also VPC Flow Logs, WAF logs.
Alarm topic (SNS) sends email to the operators.
ACCOUNT GOVERNANCE AND SECURITY (terraform/account and bootstrap, applied once)
Who did what, including every KMS use.
Application roles cannot write or delete.
Only named log admins can delete.
Security Hub: AWS best practice checks
OIDC roles: plan, deploy dev, deploy prod
Terraform state in S3, encrypted, locked
AWS Budget USD 40 with email alerts
Every resource is created by Terraform from one root module (terraform/platform). Prod differs from dev only in terraform/envs/prod/terraform.tfvars.
Account settings: EBS encryption by default, S3 public access blocked for the whole account, IAM password policy, no public sharing of SSM documents.
Nothing runs outside eu-west-1. Dashboards are a global console view of eu-west-1 metrics.
GitHub OIDC: short lived deploy role, no stored keys

and puts a message on SQS
